_meta.name: HPV up-to-date, males and females aged 13–17 years
_meta.note: CDC NIS-Teen survey-year share of males and females aged 13–17 years meeting the publisher's HPV up-to-date definition. Paired with teenHpv1DoseFemales, which measures at least one dose in females only; both dose definition and sex scope differ.
_meta.breaks: Different dose definition and sex scope from teenHpv1DoseFemales; use the publisher's up-to-date definition for each survey year.
